description: Intent i007 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=vhost-virtio-guestmem) concluded with a bounded negative result: no check-then-use double-fetch variant found in snapshots/s02. Evidence: (1) drivers/vhost/vhost.c vhost_get_vq_desc() (lines 1992-2131) fetches avail->idx once into local avail_idx with the cached wrap check at 2015, fetches ring_head once at 2035-2036 and bounds-checks head at 2046, and snapshots every descriptor via vhost_copy_from_user(&desc, vq->desc+i, sizeof desc) at 2071-2072 so all desc.addr/desc.len/desc.flags/desc.next uses at 2078-2123 consume the local copy; get_indirect() (1886-1979) and next_desc() (1873-1884) likewise operate on local snapshots with re-validation of the chained index at 2060 and 388-392. (2) drivers/vhost/vringh.c __vringh_get_head (32-70) fetches avail idx and head once and bounds-checks head at 62-66; __vringh_iov (254-399) copies each descriptor into a local 'desc' via copydesc_user/copydesc_kern (290-293) and uses only locals thereafter; accessors getu16_user/get_user (552-558), copydesc_user (566-570), getu16_kern READ_ONCE (821-826), copydesc_kern memcpy (834-838) each perform exactly one fetch. (3) vringh consumers drivers/misc/mic/vop/vop_vringh.c (init at 337) and drivers/net/caif/caif_virtio.c (call sites 257-346) consume only through the snapshotting vringh layer. 12 candidates classified safe with exact line evidence; add_used_n/notify paths (2155-2230, 2249-2269, 2302-2355) only write the used ring or use single-fetched locals. Limitations: drivers/vdpa is absent from s02 so that sub-branch was unauditable; per-driver iov consumers (vhost net.c/scsi.c/vsock.c/test.c) were enumerated but not exhaustively read (their iov inputs are built by translate_desc from local descriptor copies clamped by umem nodes, so the invariant is expected to hold upstream); static source review only, no runtime race harness. Empty findings list is deliberate and supported by the concrete negative evidence above.
